scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-preflight.js && cross-env HARDHAT_HOST=0.0.0.0 npm run dev:run
scripts.install:all: npm i && npm --prefix contracts i && npm --prefix web i
scripts.backend:test: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml run --rm -v ./backend/tests:/app/tests web python manage.py test tests
scripts.dev:run: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n node,deploy,web "npm --prefix contracts run node" "wait-on tcp:8545 && npm --prefix contracts run deploy:localhost" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:mock: node scripts/dev-preflight.js && cross-env HARDHAT_HOST=0.0.0.0 ANON_AADHAAR_VERIFIER=mock NEXT_PUBLIC_ZK_PROVER=mock npm run dev:run
